title: Occupancy entropy allocator and lease granularity tuner
author: Elena Park
description: Motivation: burst and steady-state allocation decisions in Dedicated fleets show pathological oscillation when tenant occupancy distributions stray from the assumed homogeneous model. This results in noisy headroom estimates, unnecessary prewarming, and occasional SLA blips for tail latency-sensitive tenants. This PR introduces an occupancy-entropy-based allocator and a complementary lease-granularity tuner to stabilize allocations and improve throughput guarantees without increasing overall capacity.
commits:
feat(allocator): add occupancy entropy estimator and entropy-based scoring
refactor(lease): extract lease granularity config and tuner scaffold
perf(autoscaler): integrate entropy bias into provision-decider pipeline
test(autoscaler): add deterministic harness for mixed occupancy patterns
ci: add telemetry panel snapshot for entropy metrics
diff_snippets: + func ComputeEntropy(samples []float64) float64 { /* uses log2 and small-sample bias correction */ }
review_thread: Rajat Mehra (reviewer): Can you justify using entropy vs variance? In profiling we saw variance already align with some regressors.

Elena Park (author): Entropy captures multi-modality in occupancy (e.g., some pools having many short-lived slots vs few long-lived) unlike variance which conflates magnitude and spread. Added a short benchmark in tests to demonstrate cases where variance misleads (see tests/integration/entropy_harness_test.go).
Sofia Duarte (reviewer): Telemetry payload looks fine but ensure cardinality stays bounded — suggest bucketing the lease_granularity histogram.
Elena Park (author): Bucketing added (coarse 8 buckets) and documented in telemetry comment. Also added config 'lease_granularity_buckets' to avoid cardinality explosion.
Liam O'Connor (reviewer): Safety concern: could entropy bias push allocations too conservative for bursty tenants? Please add a safeguard threshold and canary rollout.

Elena Park (author): Added safeguard: entropy_bias only applies when pool_utilization_p95 > 0.4 and there is at least 3 windows of non-empty samples. Rollout gated behind featureflag occupancy_entropy_alloc_v1 and flagged in deploy manifests.
Rajat Mehra: Approved after small nits fixed about metric names and unit tests passing.
release_notes: Introduce occupancy-entropy allocator and lease granularity tuner to improve allocation stability and reduce unnecessary prewarming. Adds new telemetry: occupancy_entropy, lease_granularity_histogram, allocation_rebalance_events. Gated behind feature flag occupancy_entropy_alloc_v1.
